# SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3

`xlsx.mjs` is an unmodified copy of the official ES module, distributed under
Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE`). It is dynamically imported from this site's own
origin for `.xlsx` inputs. No CDN request, telemetry, or workbook upload occurs.

Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/xlsx.mjs

Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/

SHA-256: `1a0fb062ee9781b13f6687371b202aaefc53b6ce55b530c027e01f9c087b77db`

To update, replace the module and license from a pinned official release,
update this record, and run the import tests and browser checks with the site's
Content-Security-Policy enabled. Do not switch to a remote runtime import.
